tools.name: set_track_graphics
tools.description: Set graphics properties for one or more tracks. The top-level properties are default values applied to all the tracks that support them, the properties of a track override the default values. A track is not modified if it doesn't support one of its own properties and the error is reported. Available properties depend on track type: label tracks (colorBackground, colorForeground, colorDuration, colorText, colorShadow, fontName, fontSize, fontStyle, lineWidth, labelLayoutPosition, labelLayoutJustification, markerStyle), value tracks (colorBackground, colorForeground, colorText, colorShadow, fontName, fontSize, fontStyle, lineWidth, unit), vector tracks (colorMap, unit). color values must be a hexadecimal color strings #RRGGBBAA (e.g. '#aabbccff') and colorMap values must be one of the following strings: 'Parula', 'Heat', 'Jet', 'Turbo', 'Hot', 'Gray', 'Magma', 'Inferno', 'Plasma', 'Viridis', 'Cividis', or 'Github'. Font style values must be one of the following strings: 'normal', 'bold', 'italic', or 'bold italic'. Label layout justification values must be one of the following strings: 'top', 'centred', or 'bottom'. Marker style values must be one of the following strings: 'bar' or 'underline'

colorMap.description: Optional default color map name (vector tracks only) applied when tracks.colorMap is omitted

colorBackground.description: Optional default background color as #RRGGBBAA (label/value tracks only) applied when tracks.colorBackground is omitted

colorForeground.description: Optional default foreground color as #RRGGBBAA (label/value tracks only) applied when tracks.colorForeground is omitted

colorDuration.description: Optional default duration color as #RRGGBBAA (label tracks only) applied when tracks.colorDuration is omitted

colorText.description: Optional default text color as #RRGGBBAA (label/value tracks only) applied when tracks.colorText is omitted

colorShadow.description: Optional default shadow color as #RRGGBBAA (label/value tracks only) applied when tracks.colorShadow is omitted

fontName.description: Optional default font typeface name (label/value tracks only) applied when tracks.fontName is omitted

fontSize.description: Optional default font size in points (label/value tracks only) applied when tracks.fontSize is omitted

fontStyle.description: Optional default font style (label/value tracks only) applied when tracks.fontStyle is omitted

lineWidth.description: Optional default line width in pixels (label/value tracks only) applied when tracks.lineWidth is omitted

unit.description: Optional default unit string (value/vector tracks only) applied when tracks.unit is omitted

labelLayoutPosition.description: Optional default label layout position (label tracks only) applied when tracks.labelLayoutPosition is omitted

labelLayoutJustification.description: Optional default label layout justification (label tracks only) applied when tracks.labelLayoutJustification is omitted

markerStyle.description: Optional default marker style (label tracks only) applied when tracks.markerStyle is omitted

identifier.description: The unique identifier of the track

colorMap.description: color map name (vector tracks only, 'Parula', 'Heat', 'Jet', 'Turbo', 'Hot', 'Gray', 'Magma', 'Inferno', 'Plasma', 'Viridis', 'Cividis', or 'Github')

tools.name: create_tracks_with_plugins
tools.description: Create multiple tracks from Vamp plugins. The tracks are created in order and the tracks that cannot be created (invalid plugin, group or parameter) are reported as errors while the other tracks are created. IMPORTANT: minimize repetition by factoring shared values into the top-level global fields. If multiple tracks use the same plugin, groupIdentifier, or parameter value, specify it once globally and omit it from those tracks. Per-track fields are overrides and should contain ONLY values that differ from the global values. Global parameters are applied to every created track first, then per-track parameters override global parameters with the same key. A global parameter may be used even if no track explicitly declares that parameter. Prefer the most compact representation that preserves the requested configuration.

plugin.description: Global default Vamp plugin shared by all tracks that omit tracks.plugin. IMPORTANT: if multiple tracks use the same plugin, define it here once and omit tracks.plugin from those tracks. Per-track plugin is only for tracks using a different plugin.

groupIdentifier.description: Global default group identifier shared by all tracks that omit tracks.groupIdentifier. IMPORTANT: if multiple tracks belong to the same group, define it here once and omit tracks.groupIdentifier from those tracks. Per-track groupIdentifier is only for tracks belonging to a different group. Defaults to the top group of the document.

parameters.description: Global default parameter values applied to every created track. IMPORTANT: factor out parameters that have the same value on multiple tracks into this array instead of repeating them in tracks[].parameters. Global parameters are applied first; per-track parameters with the same key override the global value. A global parameter may be used even if no track explicitly declares that parameter.

key.description: The identifier of the parameter to modify

tracks.description: Tracks to create. Use global plugin, groupIdentifier, and parameters whenever values are shared. Omit per-track fields when they match the global values. Per-track fields are overrides and should contain ONLY values that differ from the global configuration.

plugin.description: Per-track plugin override. Omit when the track uses the global plugin.

groupIdentifier.description: Per-track group override. Omit when the track uses the global group.

name.description: Optional custom name for the created track; defaults to the automatic plugin/feature name

parameters.description: Per-track parameter overrides. Include ONLY parameters whose values differ from the global values. A parameter with the same key as a global parameter overrides that global value for this track.

key.description: The identifier of the parameter to override

position.description: Optional insertion position within the group (0 index is the bottom track, then tracks go toward the top). Defaults to the top. Values greater than the number of tracks insert at the top.

results.description: For each requested item in the same order, the result or an object with an error message

identifier.description: The unique identifier of the new track

name.description: The name of the new track
